**What This Position Entails**
 The Software Engineer III will play a pivotal role in shaping the execution of innovative technology solutions for the Insurtech industry. As a key member of our Irix Core development team, you will be responsible for creating and modernizing product solutions central to our most\-used offerings based on market needs and product requirements. The ideal candidate will be driven to deliver quality software, get it in front of clients, and an eagerness to collaborate across a diverse group of engineers and stakeholders in order to adapt for success.
   

  

 As a software engineer focused on prescription, health, and medical record ordering solutions, you thrive in fast\-moving, modernization development and can balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to help us achieve product\-market fit and scale. You will have the opportunity to help lead the development of new processes and workflows that will become the core of many products that drive efficiency, compliance, and value for our clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Design, develop, maintain and improve software and other technical solutions that solve business challenges
* Play a key role in redesigning our monolithic legacy products in AWS
* Champion AWS best practices
* Mentoring team members on software engineering best practices
* Focus on overall product quality
* Develop and maintain unit and integration tests
* Responsibly self\-manage workload given project priorities, deadlines and deliverables
* Help the team achieve sprint goals through independent work and collaboration
* Participate in code reviews to promote quality and best practices
* Support code deployments
